privacy: Generated symbolic notes only. No live project, MIDI file, or audio was sent.

response.explanation: The exact-json representation provides fully explicit, rational-timed musical event records allowing exact structural inspection and reconstruction.
Compact-bar format provides concise, bar-structured symbolic music with exact rational timing and explicit track identities.
ABC 2.1 with side ledgers augments traditional portable tune notation with precise, machine-readable performance metadata per note event.
Alda uses an intuitive text-based notation for sequencing and playback, paired here with an exact side ledger defining precise note timings and velocities.
This representation encodes multi-track symbolic performance as an autoregressive token stream with explicit note identifiers and delta time shifts.
REMI-plus formats symbolic music into a token stream where compound note tokens specify bar-relative timing alongside absolute bar markers.
Octuple-midi encodes multi-track symbolic music as compound token tuples that bundle musical attributes alongside bar and position markers.
